intent: Thank a friend for helping, casually
context: Texting a friend after they helped with something small
chinese: 作业的事多亏有你，太感谢了！
pinyin: Zuòyè de shì duōkuī yǒu nǐ, tài gǎnxiè le!
english: Couldn't have done the homework without you, thanks so much!
nuance: Warm and natural. 多亏有你 is how friends give each other credit.

intent: Ask a classmate to study together tomorrow
context: Before a test, asking a classmate to review together
chinese: 明天有空吗？要不要一起复习？
pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu kòng ma? Yào bu yào yìqǐ fùxí?
english: Free tomorrow? Want to review together?
nuance: Check availability first, then suggest. 复习 fits when a test is coming.

intent: Thank a host mother for a delicious dinner
context: Host family, speaking to the mother after dinner
chinese: 阿姨，今天的菜太好吃了，谢谢您辛苦做饭！
pinyin: Āyí, jīntiān de cài tài hǎochī le, xièxie nín xīnkǔ zuòfàn!
english: Auntie, the food today was amazing, thank you for cooking!
nuance: 您 and 辛苦 acknowledge her effort, which matters with elders.

intent: Apologize to a teacher for a late assignment
context: Messaging a teacher after missing a deadline
chinese: 老师您好，很抱歉作业交晚了，给您添麻烦了，下次一定按时交。
pinyin: Lǎoshī nín hǎo, hěn bàoqiàn zuòyè jiāo wǎn le, gěi nín tiān máfan le, xiàcì yídìng ànshí jiāo.
english: Hello teacher, I'm very sorry the assignment was late and for the trouble. I'll hand it in on time next time.
nuance: 抱歉, 您, 添麻烦 and a promise to do better: the shape of a respectful apology.
